global.coordinates: Root-centered; rotated so the root-lean min-to-max width chord points right. These are fitted display positions, not PCA coefficients or raw knob axes.

balanced.coordinates: Root-centered; rotated so the root-lean min-to-max width chord points right. These are fitted display positions, not PCA coefficients or raw knob axes.

paths.coordinates: Root-centered; rotated so the root-lean min-to-max width chord points right. These are fitted display positions, not PCA coefficients or raw knob axes.

balanced.stop_reason: STOP: TOTAL NO. OF ITERATIONS REACHED LIMIT

paths.stop_reason: STOP: TOTAL NO. OF ITERATIONS REACHED LIMIT

definitions.global_error: Relative RMS error of all distinct image-pair Euclidean distances in the original 784 values.
definitions.tick_error: RMS relative error of available increasing width or lean ticks, with the final backward interval reused at upper bounds.
definitions.crossing_angle: Angle between those actual finite width and lean vectors, compared with the same two vectors in the drawing.
definitions.path_length: Sum of consecutive mesh-edge image distances along a fixed-width or fixed-lean curve; sampled polygonal length.
definitions.regularization: Image-pair stress plus relative local-distance stress, cosine-angle error, and an original-triangle-area penalty. It does not certify optimality, prevent every inversion, or eliminate global self-overlap.
definitions.turn_error: Absolute difference between original and drawn angles of consecutive increasing segments along the same path; median and 95th percentile reported separately for width and lean.

understanding_check.object: The connected two families of actual image curves; not pixel-coordinate coloring
understanding_check.axes: Blue fixed-lean width paths and orange fixed-width lean paths; display positions fit the 784D metric
understanding_check.baseline: Root point and its two complete paths highlighted
understanding_check.evidence: Actual versus drawn crossing vectors, sampled path lengths, all-pair error, and orientation reversals
understanding_check.scope: Finite fixed-center fixed-height sheet; measured approximation, no exact global flattening claim
